lines.trans: Senya, take this money for your silence.
And now everyone get out of here quickly.
Tell her that all the fish is fresh.
Forgive me, things turned out very awkwardly for us.
You were supposed to be in her place.

Alright, let us try to discuss everything now.
In short, I am leaving here soon.
I decided to leave Moscow forever.
I am going back to my native Voronezh.
My train leaves tomorrow morning already.
I simply wanted you to know.

examples.trans: I am going back to my native Voronezh.

examples.text: Ну что, родной мой, за тебя!
examples.trans: Well then, my dear friend, to you!

examples.text: Это мой родной город.
examples.trans: This is my hometown.

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian personal or demonstrative pronoun meaning 'my', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Мой поезд уходит уже завтра утром.
examples.trans: My train leaves tomorrow morning already.

examples.text: Вот мой сын на меня обиделся.
examples.trans: So my son got offended at me.

examples.text: Мы отдали мой костюм в химчистку.
examples.trans: We gave my suit to the dry cleaners.

meanings.note: Common masculine noun meaning 'a train' in everyday Russian.

examples.text: Костя, я в поездах играл в карты.
examples.trans: Kostya, I played cards on trains.

examples.text: Мой поезд уходит уже завтра утром.
examples.trans: My train leaves tomorrow morning already.

examples.text: Папа, поехали сейчас вместе к нам домой.
examples.trans: Dad, let us go home to our place together right now.

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian conversational adverb meaning 'already', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Мой поезд уходит уже завтра утром.
examples.trans: My train leaves tomorrow morning already.

examples.text: Ты что, реально уже завтра уезжаешь?
examples.trans: Are you really leaving tomorrow already?

examples.text: Подождите, я что, уже совсем уволен?
examples.trans: Wait, am I already completely fired?

meanings.note: Prefix 'за-' marks beginning an action, covering, or stopping by along the way (stem 'втра').

examples.text: Мой поезд уходит уже завтра утром.
examples.trans: My train leaves tomorrow morning already.

examples.text: Я завтра уезжаю навсегда.
examples.trans: I am leaving forever tomorrow.

examples.text: Ты что, реально уже завтра уезжаешь?
examples.trans: Are you really leaving tomorrow already?

meanings.note: Common neuter noun meaning 'in the morning' in everyday Russian.

examples.text: Мой поезд уходит уже завтра утром.
examples.trans: My train leaves tomorrow morning already.

examples.text: Кто ходит в бары по утрам?
examples.trans: Who goes to bars in the morning?

examples.text: Доброе утро!
examples.trans: Good morning!

meanings.note: Manner/predicative adverb in '-о', derived from the neuter short form of the corresponding adjective.

examples.text: Просто подойди к ней и спроси.
examples.trans: Just walk up to her and ask.

examples.text: Слушай, может быть, я просто уеду?
examples.trans: Listen, maybe I will just go away?

examples.text: В его возрасте такое непросто нарисовать.
examples.trans: At his age it is not easy to draw something like this.

meanings.note: Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'wanted', paired with 'захотеть'.

examples.text: Я просто хотел, чтобы ты знала.
examples.trans: I simply wanted you to know.

examples.text: Он хотел играть с богатым иностранцем.
examples.trans: He wanted to play with a rich foreigner.

examples.text: Я хотел сначала сказать только тебе.
examples.trans: I wanted to tell only you first.

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian clause-linking conjunction meaning 'so that, in order to', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: А что всё это тогда значит?
examples.trans: And what does all of this mean then?

examples.text: Что именно я ей сейчас скажу?
examples.trans: What exactly will I say to her now?

examples.text: Я скажу, что уезжаю отсюда навсегда.
examples.trans: I will say that I am leaving here forever.

meanings.note: Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'knew'.

examples.text: А что всё это тогда значит?
examples.trans: And what does all of this mean then?

examples.text: Я просто хотел, чтобы ты знала.
examples.trans: I simply wanted you to know.

examples.text: Значит, завтра на работу не выйдешь.
examples.trans: So you will not come in to work tomorrow.
